narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were one, the layoff in month {layoff_month} included. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, in that same month. The ghost's days ran a little flatter, with Life {life_gap}. A shade more of its pay was claimed before each month began, with Freedom {freedom_gap}. The ghost finished holding {net_worth_gap}.
